## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher's 8 attempts break the 3-attempt retry cap, and the exemption that would allow them is added by this same pull request, so this must be resolved before merge. The fetcher also does not retry a connection dropped mid-body, the failure its retry loop exists to absorb.

## Changes
Adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (8-attempt fetch of the legacy inventory service) and `app/health.py` (3-attempt health probe), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. Adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:49 — correctness — Keep the legacy fetcher within the 3-attempt retry cap — When the legacy service is down, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts, breaking `docs/review-rules.md:5` (applied through `AGENTS.md:3`): "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so this review does not treat it as a rule in force. — Each call holds its worker for about 87 s (8 timeouts of 10 s plus 7 delays of 1 s) when the upstream hangs: the outage the rule cites. — Fix: Either keep 3 attempts and lengthen `RETRY_DELAY` to span the restart, or land the exemption as a separate change approved by the rule's owners with a stated bound for `app/legacy/`.

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:66 — correctness — Retry a connection dropped mid-body in fetch_inventory — When the legacy service closes the connection partway through a response that has a Content-Length or chunked body, `resp.read()` at line 63 raises `http.client.IncompleteRead`. That exception is an `HTTPException`, not an `OSError`, so `except OSError` does not retry it. — The fetch fails on its first attempt during the nightly restart whose dropped connections the retry loop exists to ride out. — Fix: Catch `http.client.IncompleteRead` alongside `OSError`, update the docstring, and extend `test_returns_body` in `tests/test_retries.py` with that error.
